project_type: Python backend (KiroCrew) with a bundled web dashboard SPA; the change here is backend-only in src/kiro_crew/
build_system: Makefile wraps a venv provisioned by ensure-python.sh / setup.sh. `make backend` builds the venv; `make test` builds then runs pytest. System python3 in this sandbox is 3.9 but the project requires >= 3.12, so the coder MUST provision the >=3.12 venv (ensure-python.sh / setup.sh / `make backend`) before importing kiro_crew or running pytest.
test_framework: pytest (pytest==9.0.3, pytest-asyncio==0.20.3, pytest-xdist). Tests live under test/. Async tests need @pytest.mark.asyncio. There is a large root conftest.py.
build_command: make backend  (provisions the >=3.12 venv and installs the package in editable mode). If make is unavailable, run ./ensure-python.sh then pip install -e . into that interpreter.
test_command: Run the venv's pytest against the two affected files first: pytest test/test_acp_tool_search.py -q  and any new test file. Full suite: pytest -q (slow; use pytest-xdist). Single file is the normal dev loop per CONTRIBUTING.md.
verification_instructions: 1) Provision the >=3.12 venv (make backend or ensure-python.sh). 2) Run pytest on test/test_acp_tool_search.py plus the new test module and confirm all pass. 3) Confirm `python -c 'import kiro_crew.providers.acp'` succeeds in that venv. 4) Lint per CONTRIBUTING.md: black (line length 100), isort, flake8 (F401 unused imports, N806). There is a black baseline at .github/black-baseline.txt.
snapshot_or_generated_files: config-baseline.json and error-code-baseline.json are checked-in baselines; a schema/config change can require regenerating them. This task adds NO new config keys (reuses agent.tool_search_min_pct / tool_search_min_tokens), so no baseline regeneration is expected. If a baseline test fails, the coder should follow the regeneration command referenced in that test's failure message rather than editing the baseline by hand.
setup_instructions: From repo root /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew: run `make backend` (preferred) or `./ensure-python.sh && <venv>/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'`. Network mode is OPEN_INTERNET so package installs are allowed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (full network). No live kiro-cli backend is available in the sandbox, so verification is host-side pytest with mocked AcpClient (the existing tests already mock kiro_crew.providers.acp.AcpClient with MagicMock). The deferral ENGINE (search-and-call, deciding to defer, re-injecting specs after context shrinks) lives in kiro-cli on the far side of the ACP boundary and is NOT in this repo; it cannot be fixed or tested here.
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md: line length 100 (black), isort + black + flake8 (F401, N806, W504). Async tests use @pytest.mark.asyncio. Keep the existing code style: heavy docstrings explaining WHY (see acp.py). Never use em dashes in new prose (the repo uses them but the task convention forbids them in our written artifacts; in code comments match surrounding style but prefer plain hyphens in NEW comments).
key_patterns: The Tool Search settings are written into a per-session workspace overlay <work_dir>/.kiro/settings/cli.json by `_write_tool_search_overlay(work_dir, enabled, min_pct, min_tokens)` in src/kiro_crew/providers/acp.py (flat dotted keys toolSearch.enabled / toolSearch.minPct / toolSearch.minTokens). This overlay overrides the user's global ~/.kiro/settings/cli.json and never mutates global settings. The provider applies it via `_apply_tool_search_overlay()`, called in __init__ (kiro runtime backends) and in start() before every (re)spawn. Defaults: TOOL_SEARCH_DEFAULT_MIN_PCT=5, TOOL_SEARCH_DEFAULT_MIN_TOKENS=50_000. Config keys agent.tool_search / tool_search_min_pct / tool_search_min_tokens are read in src/kiro_crew/config/loader.py (~lines 2579-2582, 3993-4118) and defined in src/kiro_crew/config/sections.py (~757-790). The CLOSEST existing precedent for a live per-session lever is `change_effort(level)` / `clear_effort()` on AcpProvider (acp.py ~1121-1246): it snapshots prior state, rewrites the overlay via _apply_effort_overlay(), pushes live, and rolls back on failure. It is gated on backend membership (ACP_BACKENDS_KIRO_SLASH_COMMANDS) and is exposed to the dashboard via src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_handlers.py. The provider has `start()` (re-applies overlays then spawns/ensures runtime) and `shutdown()`; the kiro path swaps self._client to an AcpSessionProvider in _start_kiro_runtime_impl.
relevant_files: src/kiro_crew/providers/acp.py (overlay writer ~143-200; TOOL_SEARCH_DEFAULT_* ~121-122; provider __init__ tool_search fields ~360-386; _apply_tool_search_overlay ~1026-1060; change_effort/clear_effort precedent ~1121-1246; start/shutdown ~1245-1291; compact ~1405-1440)
src/kiro_crew/providers/base.py (LLMProvider interface; add any new method to the abstract surface if consumers call through it)
src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_handlers.py (how change_effort is wired to the dashboard; the escape-hatch entry point if a dashboard surface is added)
test/test_acp_tool_search.py (test conventions: MagicMock AcpClient, tmp_path cli.json helper)
directory_structure: src/kiro_crew/providers/ holds LLM provider implementations (acp.py is the ACP/kiro-cli + claude-agent-acp provider; base.py the interface). src/kiro_crew/config/ holds config dataclasses (sections.py), the loader (loader.py) and schema (schema.py). src/kiro_crew/acp/ holds the ACP client/runtime/session layer. Tests are flat under test/. The upstream deferral engine is in kiro-cli, a separate repo not present here.
